hero.eyebrow: BIST + Global Markets · Risk & Portfolio Analytics
hero.title: Financial Risk & <accent>Portfolio Analysis</accent> Platform
hero.lead: Explore historical price data for BIST stocks, see core risk and return metrics, and build your own portfolio to analyze its performance. Use the search bar above to add any stock to your watchlist.

steps.title: How It Works
steps.step1Desc: Search any stock/ETF on Yahoo Finance with the search bar above, and add it to your watchlist with one click.
steps.step2Desc: Volatility, maximum drawdown, Sharpe ratio, and technical indicators are computed automatically for every asset.
steps.step3Desc: Build a weighted portfolio out of multiple assets; compare its performance against the BIST 100 index.

features.title: What's on the Platform
features.marketDesc: Watch the assets you track as live cards or a table; filter, sort, and compare across time periods.
features.assetsDesc: Dig into a single stock with a candlestick chart, SMA/RSI/MACD technical indicators, and a period-by-period performance table.
features.portfolioDesc: Build a weighted portfolio; measure its risk and return with asset allocation, a correlation matrix, and a BIST 100 comparison.

cta.title: Analyze your own portfolio now
cta.body: Build a portfolio in a few minutes, and measure its risk and return with real data.
cta.point2: Free to sign up, no card required

netWorth.title: Net Worth Summary
netWorth.mixedCurrencyNote: Some portfolios hold positions in different currencies; totals are combined by converting to TRY at a current exchange rate.

netWorthHistory.title: Net Worth History (TRY)
netWorthHistory.caveat: This chart only traces positions still open today, from their purchase date onward — fully closed positions are not included.
netWorthHistory.caveatExcluded: {{tickers}} could not be included since no price/exchange-rate data was available.
